name: @aria-live/mcp
description: MCP bridge: lets Codex, Claude Code or Aria Code pick up the task a Twitch community voted for and report progress to the stream.

scripts.build:plugin:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=../../plugin/mcp/aria-live-mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:proxy:
esbuild src/proxy-main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/aria-live-proxy.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
